en.draw_stage: This panel shows equipment-only draw intervals. Combat combines equipment and temporary speed, then clamps to 1.8–6 seconds. PVE draw-block conversion halves the interval after that clamp and expires normally.
en.not_applicable: Not applicable to this class (not capped excess)
en.resistance_stage: Element resistance is capped at 60%; excess adds no effective resistance.
en.shield_stage: Shield is capped at half the class base health. Requested, effective and overflow shield are counted separately.

zh-CN.draw_stage: 这里只显示装备抽牌间隔。战斗中先合并装备和临时加速，再限制到 1.8–6 秒；PVE 抽牌阻断转加速在限制后将间隔减半，结束后恢复。
zh-CN.inactive_affix: 套装未激活（不是超过上限）
zh-CN.not_applicable: 此职业不适用（不是超过上限）
zh-CN.resistance_stage: 元素抗性最高 60%；超过上限的部分不会提高生效抗性。
zh-CN.shield_stage: 护盾上限是职业基础生命的一半；请求护盾、实际获得和溢出分别统计。
